coaching.headline: Shinbi finished 10-0 and closed it personally, killing three of ours alone in the final fight at 25.8, after an offlane caught out three times before minute 14. Towers finished one to their seven.
coaching.team: The draft left one favored lane on paper, Kira's carry matchup, with the other four read as theirs. It played out through the offlane first: Legion was caught alone three times between 9 and 13.1, and the second and third catches each had an outer tower fall on the timer. The middle of the game was genuinely ours. The fight at 13.8 at their outer tower was won 3-1, and we cashed it into Fangtooth at 15. The river fight at 16.7 was lost 0-5, but that loss bought the Mini Prime across the map at 19. Both fights we won, we cashed, 2 for 2, including Yin's outnumbered 2-0 over Dekker and Lt. Belica at their inhibitor at 23.6. What killed us was starting fights while a death timer was running. The fight at our own Mini Prime at 19.3 opened 4v5 with Zinx down 32 seconds and was lost 1-3. Fangtooth and the inner tower both fell at 20.4 behind it. The 2v2 at their inner tower at 22.9 was the wrong fight, taken with Legion and Yin alive but pinned across the map. Our inner tower fell at 23.2 and the inhibitor at 23.5. The final fight at 25.8 was started with Renna down 37 seconds and lost 0-3, and the Core fell at 26.2. Next game, one rule: while a teammate's death timer runs, we do not start fights. Hold, reset, and take the next one 5v5.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: What made the fight at our own Mini Prime at 19.3 unwinnable? It opened 4v5, Zinx having gone down 32 seconds earlier, with Kira alive, ahead in lane, and absent. It was lost 1-3, and Fangtooth and the inner tower both fell at 20.4. That flipped a window where we had just taken Fangtooth and Mini Prime into their game-ending push.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 was caught alone three times in five minutes. Shinbi got him at 9 and again at 13.1. Scarlett took the one in between at 11.1. Two of those catches ended with outer towers falling, at 12.4 and 13.9. Offlane is graded on survival because every one of those death timers opened the river, and it ran 15 buffs to 7 theirs. The 20,665 damage dealt shows the fights were there once alive. Vanquisher, the missing piece of the 56.9% Malady, Vanquisher and Deathstalker core, never came.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 held the only lane we had favored on paper, winning at every checkpoint, and the output was 2/2/1 with 13,099 damage. Kira was alive and ahead but absent from both the fight at our Mini Prime at 19.3 and the final fight at 25.8, with the entire 56.5% Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator core skipped. Winning the lane is half the job, and arriving with the lead is the half this game needed.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's map work held up: 13 wards placed, 3 cleared, 7,306 healed — the best vision numbers on the team. The one expensive minute was the catch by Eden at 18.8, which is exactly what made the Mini Prime defense at 19.3 a 4v5. On a losing map, no death hurts more than the support going down half a minute before the objective fight.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim produced the best moment of the game, the fight at their inhibitor at 23.6, won 2-0 into Dekker and Lt. Belica while down a body, and the team went 2-for-2 cashing the fights it won. The caveats: two completed items in 26 minutes, with Lightning Hawk and Onixian Quiver missing from the 54.2% core, and no magic resist into a three-magical comp while taking 38,018 damage. The death at 19.3 was also followed by Fangtooth and the inner tower falling at 20.4.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs built the only complete winning core on the team, the 57.5% Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer set, and traded evenly at 4/4 in a mid that tilted against us late on paper. But Xeebs placed 1 ward in 26 minutes, and the solo death to Shinbi at 25.2 made the last stand a 4v5. The Core fell at 26.2.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Caught alone three times before minute 14, and two outer towers fell on those death timers, at 12.4 and 13.9. Those timers opened the river, and it ran 15 buffs to 7 against us.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: The one favored lane on paper produced 2/2/1 and was absent from both fights that ended the game, at 19.3 and 25.8. The lead stayed in the lane instead of turning into towers.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: 13 wards, 3 cleared, 7,306 healed — the support work held up on a night the rest of the map didn't.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: The fight at their inhibitor at 23.6, won 2-0 while outnumbered, and a perfect 2-for-2 cashing won fights — the right map, played on two items.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: One ward in 26 minutes from the rotation lane, and the solo death at 25.2 to a 10-0 Shinbi put the Core on the clock at 26.2 — discipline, not the build, was the gap.

coaching.whatWorked: Both won fights were cashed inside the window. The win at 13.8 at their outer tower turned into Fangtooth at 15. The outnumbered win at their inhibitor at 23.6 was cashed the same way, 2 of 2 converted. In a game this uphill, the convert-every-win habit never broke.

16.7.call: That loss at their river bought Mini Prime across the map, but a trade does not need five bodies standing in it. With the prize coming cross-map, the job was to disengage and leave with it. Staying to flip a full fight turned the trade into five death timers.

25.8.call: With Renna's timer running from the catch at 25.2, no fight was worth starting. The only play left was four together under a structure, conceding ground until the fifth was back on the map. Starting anything a body down at that stage handed Shinbi the ending.

19.3.call: The objective was in hand, and leaving with it was the play. A body down, with the support's timer running, staying to fight is exactly what the numbers punish. Take the prize, give the ground, and regroup five-strong for the Fangtooth spawn.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance
